objective: A frozen exploratory census, exact: the doubling law every P = 1 to 8 lags at g = 2 (to 48 x 48) and P = 1 to 4 at g = 3 (to 24 x 24), open and open-plus-copy births, from the 3 x 3 tube; at each doubling lag, whether some own cell hears another ring and whether the stage is balanced; the delay, in doublings, from the first hearing to the first unbalanced stage, against the bound frozen in the contract.
status: Closed: supported 2026-11-09 (exploratory, exact; frozen contract, H refuted): at g = 3 open births doubling every 2 and every 4 lags keep every stage balanced while rings hear each other, to 24 x 24, so isolation is not necessary; at g = 2 every hearing schedule fails within two doublings, and P = 1, 3, 7 isolate and stay balanced to 48 x 48; at g = 3 open plus copy and open P = 3 fail at 12 x 12. Reading further to 48 x 48 pending (ISOLATION-NEED-A2).
title: Hearing breaks balance within two doublings: a census
